classes.name: HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP)
classes.description: Emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil (Truvada and generics), emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (Descovy), cabotegravir LA (Apretude), lenacapavir (Yeztugo).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill or long-acting shot that prevents HIV.

classes.name: Single-tablet HIV treatment regimens
classes.description: Complete single-tablet regimens: bictegravir/FTC/TAF (Biktarvy), dolutegravir/abacavir/lamivudine (Triumeq), dolutegravir/lamivudine (Dovato), dolutegravir/rilpivirine (Juluca), darunavir/cobicistat/FTC/TAF (Symtuza), elvitegravir/cobi/FTC/TAF (Genvoya), rilpivirine/FTC/TAF (Odefsey), efavirenz/FTC/TDF and generics; cabotegravir/rilpivirine LA (Cabenuva).
classes.plainDescription: A once-a-day pill that treats HIV.

records.verificationNote: Read p. 69 at the page image. The PDL lists HIV PrEP agents (cabotegravir/Apretude, emtricitabine/tenofovir DF/Truvada, emtricitabine/tenofovir AF/Descovy, lenacapavir/Yeztugo) in a coverage-criteria table with no preferred or non-preferred status printed. The generic emtricitabine/tenofovir DF was picked as the lowest-cost listed oral option, which is a judgment, not a PDL preference. Dose is standard label dosing.

records.preferredRestriction: No PDL preferred/non-preferred status for ARV single-tablet regimens. p.65 ARV parameters: a complete co-formulated regimen listed in Appendix A is limited to 1 product concurrently with no additional ARVs; point-of-service edit for ARV/ARV interactions. PDL p.1: 'Not all drugs covered by NYRx are subject to programs included in this document' and 'All drugs currently covered by NYRx ... remain available under the PDP'; the NYRx PDL web page adds 'Not all agents covered by NYRx are listed on the PDL' (newyork.fhsc.com/providers/PDP_about.asp, read 2026-10-22).

records.verificationNote: Searched the full PDL text for ten or more single-tablet HIV regimens; none appear. The ARV parameter block (p. 65) sets quantity limits (one integrase inhibitor, one NNRTI, two protease inhibitors, max five ARVs concurrently) and cites Appendix A for complete regimens, but Appendix A is not in the document (pp. 84-86 are dose optimization, cost optimization and PA contact). The PDL is not a complete covered list (overview, p. 1), so this is not treated as nonformulary. Biktarvy is a class reference only. [Sonnet check 2026-10-22: noCoveredAgent removed. Biktarvy is a standard single-tablet pick, not a PDL preference. p.65 cites 'Appendix A' for complete ARV regimens but the appendix is not in the PDL; checked newyork.fhsc.com PDP_about.asp and /providers/sraarv.asp (2 fetches): the SRA page only names a supplemental-rebate list with no drug names in its HTML, and no Appendix A file was found. Coverage and any PA for Biktarvy not confirmed. Partial.]

Stays partial because the NF tier label and the PrEP-only $0 wording are not fully reconciled in the document.]
